claims.assertion: Za’el says harsh self-talk can damage self-esteem and reinforce self-sabotage because repeated words shape the unconscious and, in his view, reality.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He cites studies on negative comments.

claims.assertion: He says words directed at others can encourage them or deepen distress, particularly when they feel mentally vulnerable.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
claims.qualifiers: He says the impact depends on the listener.

claims.assertion: Za’el recommends objective, compassionate phrasing: describe difficulty rather than declaring failure, and name positive aspects without denying problems.
claims.speaker: Za’el de Erra
